test_vs_reviewed_contract.evaluation_contract_role: The expert-reviewed test set (synth_sbdh_test_reviewed.csv, 1,732 instances) is formally designated as the PRIMARY FINAL EVALUATION SET for the SDoH extraction model. It must NEVER be used for model training, preprocessing fitting, or hyperparameter tuning. The 23 records omitted from standard test represent machine-generated synthetic items that expert clinical annotators determined contained no valid SBDH cues or were unannotatable.
test_vs_reviewed_contract.operation_column_contract: The 'Operation' column (values: 'keep', 'add', 'correct') is strictly an audit and curation provenance metadata field. It must NEVER be used as a feature, input, or prediction target in any modeling pipeline.
test_vs_reviewed_contract.multi_label_architecture_requirement: In 38 rows of test_reviewed and 33 rows of train, identical text phrases are annotated for multiple SBDH categories (e.g. 'cannot afford to continue physical therapy' -> 'financial insecurity' AND 'barriers to care'). Standard single-label token classification (flat BIO tagging) will cause label collisions. The NLP extraction pipeline must employ multi-label token classification or a span-based/seq2seq extraction architecture.

independent_splits_overlap.status: PASSED - ZERO TEXT OVERLAP ACROSS INDEPENDENT SPLITS

reviewed_test_relationship.detail: The expert-reviewed test set is NOT an independent fourth dataset. It is an expert-curated ground-truth version of the test split (1,732 of 1,755 examples). Zero training or validation text appears in either test set.

synthetic_data_limitations: Synthetic clinical notes are generated via LLM prompt templates and do not exhibit authentic clinical noise (e.g. shorthand, acronyms, dictation typos).
Label co-occurrence patterns in synthetic text may reflect prompting biases rather than genuine clinical SDoH comorbidities.
Models tuned exclusively on synthetic notes risk catastrophic generalization failure when deployed on genuine EHR notes.
Synth-SBDH is strictly an educational NLP benchmark for testing extraction pipelines, NOT a clinical deployment asset.

roles_and_protocols.train: Model training and parameter optimization only.
roles_and_protocols.val: Validation, hyperparameter tuning, model selection, and early stopping.
roles_and_protocols.test_reviewed: Primary final gold-standard evaluation set (expert-reviewed). NEVER train or tune on this set.
